fullPassage: Adopting a growth mindset opens up a host of benefits that ripple through learning and life. First and foremost, it cultivates resilience. When setbacks occur — as they inevitably do — people with growth mindsets see them as temporary obstacles rather than proof of inadequacy. They tap into creativity to find new strategies and keep moving forward. This persistence often leads to greater achievement than raw talent ever could. Beyond resilience, a growth orientation encourages curiosity and experimentation. It turns mistakes from sources of shame into valuable feedback, fostering a spirit of continuous improvement. Not everyone bounces back from failure and setbacks can, for some, result in deep discouragement or even prevent them from rebuilding their resilience. And by valuing effort over outcome, individuals tend to maintain motivation longer, enjoying progress for its own sake rather than just external validation. * ripple through ~에 확산되다 ** resilience 회복력
